The completed comparison places control near autonomous machinery and offers a provisional guarantee analogy for the exposed humans, while explicitly leaving nonworking inapplicable because there is no scoped civilian person denominator. This is a thematic non-fit, not an omission caused by obscure household law. The game’s unverified ending economies are not imported into the novel.
